summary.tldr: Clarifies when the Public Safety Minister can direct the RCMP Commissioner and requires those directions to be written, tabled in Parliament, and published.
what_it_does: Limits ministerial directions to setting RCMP priorities, objectives and policies.
Bans directions on day to day operations, specific investigations, arrests, prosecutions, and other matters that would interfere with the Commissioner’s control and management powers.
Requires the Minister to issue every direction in writing.
Requires the Minister to table each direction in both Houses of Parliament within the first 15 sitting days after it is issued.
Requires each direction to be published in the Canada Gazette, and says it is not a statutory instrument under the Statutory Instruments Act.
who_it_affects: Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness
summary.background: The bill adds a new section to the Royal Canadian Mounted Police Act. It deals with directions the Minister of Public Safety and Emergency Preparedness can issue to the RCMP Commissioner.
